section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection between the service of "and I will return in peace" during exile and the future redemption, where the transformation of darkness to light will reveal true peace.
section.t: And this is also the connection of the matter of "and I will return in peace to my father's house" as it is in the service of man when he is in Charan
(during the time of exile)
to the matter of "and I will return in peace to my father's house"
(as it is in the simple sense)
that it refers to the return and restoration from Charan to his father's house, that it will be in the future redemption.
[And as is also understood from this that Yitzchak
(my father)
is a future tense term,
for the matter of laughter and delight will be in the future,
as it is written182
"Then
(specifically)
our mouth will be filled with laughter."
This is also what in the future specifically they will say183
"To Yitzchak, for you are our father"184],
for through the service of "and I will return in peace,"
darkness is subjugated and transformed into light
[the matter of peace,
that even the opposing is transformed into holiness],
and not only in his body and animal soul but also in his portion in the world,
through this there will be the revelation of the future,
when then there will be the true matter of peace,
"they shall not harm nor destroy... for the earth shall be filled with knowledge of Havayah as the waters cover the sea."185

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that although Yitzchak is a future tense term, the laughter and delight already exist now through the service of subjugating darkness, with only its revelation reserved for the future.
section.t: And behold, even though Yitzchak is a future tense term because the laughter and delight above will be in the future
(as above),
nevertheless,
from the fact that he is now called by the name Yitzchak,
it is understood
that even now there is this delight and laughter
[and as it is written186
"God has made laughter for me,"
He has already made],
for the laughter and delight are generated from the service of subjugation and transformation now,
and only the revelation of the delight will be in the future
(when all the clarifications are completed).
[And so it is also regarding this that in the future they will say to Yitzchak "for you are our father" from the aspect that he will save Israel from exile,183
that a foretaste of this matter exists even now.
For even during the time of exile he protects Israel,
and this protection will afterwards be in a manner of rescue from exile187].

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that even in exile, through the power of self-sacrifice from the level of Yechidah, obstacles are nullified and even assist in serving God, analogous to the future peace.
section.t: And similarly it is also regarding the matter of peace,
that even though the true matter of peace
(in the manner of "they shall not harm nor destroy etc.")
will be in the future
(as above at the end of section 23),
nevertheless, a foretaste of this can be even now during the time of exile,
that the things that prevent and hinder etc. not only will not oppose,
but on the contrary will assist in the service of God.
And based on this it is understood
(in addition to the explanation above there)

the connection of the matter of "and I will return in peace to my father's house" as it is during the time of exile to the matter of "and I will return in peace to my father's house" that will be in the future redemption,
for even during the time of exile when there are preventers and hinderers
[to the extent that a request is needed that it be "and I will return in peace" — peace and the negation of bloodshed188],
nevertheless even then,
through the power of self-sacrifice that stems from the level of Yechidah,
all preventers and hinderers are nullified,
and moreover, they themselves assist in the service of God,
in the likeness and foretaste of the peace that will be in the future.
